source: .ros/work/queue.json at baselineCommit; criteria are an atomic decomposition of each item's 'Acceptance:' text, frozen before any arm runs
itemHashAlgorithm: sha256 of canonical JSON {id,title,description} (sorted keys, no whitespace, UTF-8)

scoring.primary: passed / scorable, where scorable = pass + fail; indeterminate is reported and never converted to pass
scoring.evidence: each score cites the command run against the built CLI of that snapshot with its observed output, or a file:line, or both

items.title: praxis work group create: durable human-declared execution group
items.description: Record a declared group (ID, members, kind, execution repository, cross-repository flag, shared context) in Praxis state. Acceptance: refuses unknown or terminal members and duplicate IDs; never changes a member's lifecycle state; the planner reads the stored declaration exactly as it reads grouping.groups; --dry-run and --json supported; validate checks stored groups. Phase two of requirements/PLANNING-WORK-GROUPS.md (covers PRX-GRP-073); proposed cohort of EX-ROS-2026-A021. Must not be merged before that experiment is evaluated and the owner accepts phase two.

criteria.text: Records a declared group with its ID, members, kind, execution repository, cross-repository flag and shared context durably in Praxis state.
Refuses an unknown member (no state change).
Refuses a terminal member, e.g. a completed or abandoned item (no state change).
Refuses a duplicate group ID (no state change).
Never changes any member's lifecycle state.
The planner reads the stored declaration exactly as it reads grouping.groups (a stored group is honoured by the planner's group output the same way a configured grouping.groups entry is).
--dry-run is supported and writes nothing.
--json is supported and emits a machine-readable result.
validate checks stored groups (an invalid stored group produces a validation finding).

items.title: praxis work group show: a declared group with member states and progress
items.description: Read-only view of one declared group: members with their own recorded and planning states, partial-completion progress, blocked members and who they gate, execution repository, architecture notes. Acceptance: text and --json; unknown group exits 1; never writes. Depends on: PRAXIS-GROUP-01. Phase two of requirements/PLANNING-WORK-GROUPS.md (covers PRX-GRP-073); proposed cohort of EX-ROS-2026-A021. Must not be merged before that experiment is evaluated and the owner accepts phase two.

criteria.text: Shows the group's members with their own recorded states and planning states.
Shows partial-completion progress.
Shows blocked members and which members they gate.
Shows the execution repository.
Shows architecture notes.
Text output is supported.
--json output is supported.
An unknown group exits with status 1.
Never writes (repository and Praxis state are byte-identical before and after).

items.title: praxis work group add: add a member to a declared group
items.description: Add one work item to a declared group. Acceptance: refuses unknown/terminal items, items already present, and an item whose execution repository differs unless the group is cross-repository; records who added it (provenance); member lifecycle untouched. Depends on: PRAXIS-GROUP-01. Phase two of requirements/PLANNING-WORK-GROUPS.md (covers PRX-GRP-073); proposed cohort of EX-ROS-2026-A021. Must not be merged before that experiment is evaluated and the owner accepts phase two.

criteria.text: Adds one work item to a declared group.
Refuses an unknown item (no state change).
Refuses a terminal item (no state change).
Refuses an item already present in the group (no state change).
Refuses an item whose execution repository differs from the group's when the group is not cross-repository.
Accepts an item whose execution repository differs when the group is cross-repository.
Records who added the member (provenance).
Leaves the member's lifecycle state untouched.

items.title: praxis work group remove: remove a member from a declared group
items.description: Remove one member from a declared group. Acceptance: refuses non-members; removal never changes the item's lifecycle state, evidence or attribution; removing the last member is refused or explicit; provenance recorded. Depends on: PRAXIS-GROUP-01. Phase two of requirements/PLANNING-WORK-GROUPS.md (covers PRX-GRP-073); proposed cohort of EX-ROS-2026-A021. Must not be merged before that experiment is evaluated and the owner accepts phase two.

criteria.text: Removes one member from a declared group.
Refuses a non-member (no state change).
Removal never changes the removed item's lifecycle state, evidence or attribution.
Removing the last member is either refused or requires an explicit option.
Records provenance for the removal.

items.title: praxis work group checkpoint: a group checkpoint over members' own checkpoints
items.description: Record a group checkpoint (PRX-GRP-044): group ID, active/completed/remaining members, shared architectural decisions, branch and commit, next action. Acceptance: requires the same durable-checkpoint verification as work checkpoint; references members' own checkpoints and never replaces them; no member claims another's changes (PRX-GRP-043). Depends on: PRAXIS-GROUP-01, PRAXIS-GROUP-02. Phase two of requirements/PLANNING-WORK-GROUPS.md (covers PRX-GRP-073); proposed cohort of EX-ROS-2026-A021. Must not be merged before that experiment is evaluated and the owner accepts phase two.

criteria.text: Records a group checkpoint containing the group ID, active, completed and remaining members, shared architectural decisions, branch and commit, and next action.
Requires the same durable-checkpoint verification as work checkpoint (refuses when HEAD is not the pushed upstream head or meaningful work is uncommitted).
References members' own checkpoints.
Never replaces or rewrites members' own checkpoints.
No member claims another member's changes (PRX-GRP-043).
